222	/****************************************************************************
223	 * Name: esp32p4_getreg
224	 *
225	 * Description:
226	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
227	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
228	 *   this driver.
229	 *
230	 * Input Parameters:
231	 *   addr - The register address to read
232	 *
233	 * Returned Value:
234	 *   The value read from the register
235	 *
236	 ****************************************************************************/
237	
238	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
239	static uint32_t __esp32p4_getreg(const char* func, uint32_t addr) {
240	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
241	  static uint32_t preval = 0;
242	  static uint32_t count = 0;
243	
244	  /* Read the value from the register */
245	
246	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
247	
248	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
249	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
250	   */
251	
252	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval) {
253	    if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3) {
254	      if (count == 4) {
255	        mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
256	      }
257	
258	      return val;
259	    }
260	  }
261	
262	  /* No this is a new address or value */
263	
264	  else {
265	    /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
266	
267	    if (count > 3) {
268	      /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
269	
270	      mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
271	    }
272	
273	    /* Save the new address, value, and count */
274	
275	    prevaddr = addr;
276	    preval = val;
277	    count = 1;
278	  }
279	
280	  /* Show the register value read */
281	
282	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
283	  return val;
284	}
285	#endif

222	/****************************************************************************
223	 * Name: esp32p4_getreg
224	 *
225	 * Description:
226	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
227	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
228	 *   this driver.
229	 *
230	 * Input Parameters:
231	 *   addr - The register address to read
232	 *
233	 * Returned Value:
234	 *   The value read from the register
235	 *
236	 ****************************************************************************/
237	
238	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
239	static uint32_t __esp32p4_getreg(const char* func, uint32_t addr) {
240	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
241	  static uint32_t preval = 0;
242	  static uint32_t count = 0;
243	
244	  /* Read the value from the register */
245	
246	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
247	
248	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
249	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
250	   */
251	
252	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval) {
253	    if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3) {
254	      if (count == 4) {
255	        mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
256	      }
257	
258	      return val;
259	    }
260	  }
261	
262	  /* No this is a new address or value */
263	
264	  else {
265	    /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
266	
267	    if (count > 3) {
268	      /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
269	
270	      mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
271	    }
272	
273	    /* Save the new address, value, and count */
274	
275	    prevaddr = addr;
276	    preval = val;
277	    count = 1;
278	  }
279	
280	  /* Show the register value read */
281	
282	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
283	  return val;
284	}
285	#endif
